brief: Holds a model-backed agent that proposes candidates and can never commit an effect on its own.
detail: It has the same shape as stzPIAgent but its body is a stzLLMFunction, and its capability set is inference only: HoldsEffectful answers 0 whatever is done to it, so the agent graph and the guardrails treat it as an llm_actor that a guarded pi-actor must admit before anything happens. Propose returns the model function's answer as a candidate. Documented and run here with a seeded answer, so no model is loaded and nothing is called over a network.
receiver:
o1 = new stzLLMAgent("summarizer")
o2 = new stzLLMFunction("sum")
